items.title: Maternity blind spot in Bangladesh cricket

items.title: 'After Maghrib, I learned I was rested': Ashraful blindsided by BCB axe before West Indies series
items.summary: Bangladesh batting coach Mohammad Ashraful spent Saturday morning in the trenches, meticulously supervising national team practice at the Sher-e-Bangla National Cricket Stadium and drawing up batting blueprints for the impending Mirpur Test against West Indies on October 28. By nightfall, he was out of a job, at least one with the national team.
